Into the Dream Cradle
Into the Dream Cradle
Casting this skill sends Lily into Slumberland and grants Cradle Lullaby to Resonators in the team.
Casting this skill also grants Lily a Shield equal to 100% of her Max HP for 4s. This Shield does not carry over to the incoming Resonator.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

Slumber
Lasts for 50s. When Lily is in Slumberland, she heals the nearby active Resonator every 3s. During Slumberland, use directional input to command Dreambind to deal Spectro DMG to nearby targets. Dreambind pulls in targets within a certain range every 5s, and stops attacking 10s after movement stops. Press Resonance Liberation again during Slumberland to end it early.
When Lily is in Slumberland, when a Resonator in the team casts Intro Skill, targets within a certain range are pulled in, triggered once every 10s. Lily is immune to interruption during Slumberland and takes 50% less DMG.
Switching to another Resonator during Slumberland keeps Lily on the field, and she takes no DMG while in Slumberland. Lily leaves the field when Slumberland ends, or earlier if she gets too far from the active Resonator.

Cradle Lullaby
Lasts for 25s. While this effect is active, each Intro Skill cast by a Resonator in the team grants 1 stack of Dream Aroma. This effect is removed when Lily is the incoming Resonator.

Dream Aroma
Stacks up to 4 times. Each stack increases the ATK of all Resonators inon the team by 7%, stacking0.1% for every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen above 190%, up to 4 times7%. This effect is removed when Lily is the incoming Resonator or when Cradle Lullaby ends.
Casting this skill sends Lily into Slumberland and grants Cradle Lullaby to all Resonators in the team.
Casting this skill also grants a Shield.

Slumberland
While in Slumberland, Lily continuously heals the active Resonator.
During Slumberland, when a Resonator in the team casts Intro Skill, targets within a certain range are pulled in.

Cradle Lullaby
While this effect is active, when the active Resonator casts Intro Skill, the ATK of all Resonators in the team is increased. This effect is removed when Lily is the incoming Resonator.

Blooming Dream
Blooming Dream
First Bloom
Attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG. Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

Eternal Bloom
After casting Resonance Liberation - Into the Dream Cradle, Lily's next Intro Skill First Bloom is replaced with Eternal Bloom. When cast, it attacks the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
For every 1% of Lily's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, this skill gains an additional 0.5% Crit. Rate, up to 80%, and an additional 1% Crit. DMG, up to 160%.
Casting the skill grants Deep Dream Fragrance for 8s. Casting Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale or Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm consumes Deep Dream Fragrance to additionally grant 100 points of Dreambell Chime.
Press Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

Dreamland of Flowers
Dreamland of Flowers
Dream Perfume
Lily can hold up to 300 points.
Basic Attack, Mid-air Attack, and Dodge Counter restore Dream Perfume on hit.
CastingAfter casting Resonance Skill - Reverie Blend or Resonance Skill - Nightmare Blend restores, restore 130 points of Dream Perfume.
Casting Intro Skill - Eternal Bloom restores 130 points of Dream Perfume.

Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale
When Dream Perfume is full, hold Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale, consuming all Dream Perfume to pull in nearby targets, dealing Spectro DMGgrant 1 stack of Dream Shelter. During the skill, she gains 10% DMG Reductionpulls in nearby targets and continuously deals Spectro DMG to nearby targetsthem. She also heals all Resonators in the team every second for 2s.
Casting Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale grants Lily Wish of Praying Dream, which can be gained once every 25s. When Lily has Wish of Praying Dream, this Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale consumes Wish of Praying Dream to increase the healing by 400%.
Switching to another Resonator during Heavy Attack - Woven Fairytale stops the skills immediately.
Lily continuously gains Dreambell Chime during the skill.
When Dreambell Chime reaches 300 points, press or hold Normal Attack to stop the skill immediately and cast Heavy Attack - Fairytale's Finale. Attack targets within range, dealing Spectro DMG.

Casting the skill grants Lily Sillage for 6s. Casting Outro Skill consumes Sillage and grants Silvered Dream to Resonators in the team. This effect can be triggered once every 25s20s.

Heavy Attack - Woven Phantasm
